fact: NaCSA says Economic Inclusion Grants under the PSSNYE social safety net project were disbursed through Afri-money mobile money to selected beneficiaries in Falaba District, marking the start of disbursements across the chiefdom.
Officials say retired citizens can receive NACSA support directly through mobile money wallets.

Sierraloaded reports NaCSA signed an agreement with Afrimoney on 15 April 2025 to deliver cash transfers to over 11,600 elderly beneficiaries under a World Bank-funded safety-net programme; no payments yet stated as made.
Sierra Leone's labour ministry and NaCSA began a World Bank-supported cash transfer of NLe1,018 to 13,091 people aged 60+ in 10 districts, paid by Orange Mobile Money.
